summary: DoorDash filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 annual meeting of stockholders. Three routine proposals were voted on: election of four Class III directors (all elected), ratification of KPMG as auditor, and advisory approval of executive compensation (approved). Item 8.01 provides updated contact information for stockholder proposals for the 2027 annual meeting. This is a standard current report of a regular annual meeting with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The filing reflects routine corporate governance and administrative matters.
